-Bun 4-1 fixed
-Rare Electric Bug Fixed

notes.title: Marble Maid 2 Mega Patch!!!
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-Meshball Fixes
-Camera Angle Interaction Fixes
-Changing Powerups during your
-Lava to Water Tile Movement doesnt act instantly
-Artwork Credits fixed
-Waredrobe Glitch now fixed
-Total Board Invisible Button Removed
-Golf Soft Lock been Removed

[b]New Features[/b]
-New Golf Camera (To see the entire course)
-Lock On for Boss Mode (Hit the Boss with ease!)
-Coin UI now added to game
-Entering Secret Level now warps you instead of just letting you sit there
-New Level Hubs now show beam of light
-Outline of Maid appears on walls so you can see her through walls
-Two new fan arts have been added

notes.title: Marble Maid Speedrun Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Speedrun Mode has been fixed (Now you can score on the leaderboard for running the game)
[*] Few small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Marble Maid 2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Phasing through Pinball Boss Now Fixed
-Sideways glitch fixed (mostly)
-Bun through the glass glitch fixed
-Buns traveling through wires can now go through walls
-Slider for quality now adjusted to not make darkness too affected durning low computer settings
-Nega Maid Mirror Boss fight now fixed with ramp electric dash bug
-Controller Support has been added
